Lisa N: Morning @finance :wave: — I had to expedite my passport today for relocating to NYC next week. Paid $180 USD for expedited service + $25 courier. Can this be reimbursed under relocation? I used my personal card. I have photos of receipts.

Alex K: Hey Lisa :wave: — Welcome! Relocation should cover reasonable expedited fees. Can you upload receipts to Ramp and tag `relocation`? We'll need manager approval. Rough GL: `RELO-TRAVEL`.

Lisa N: Uploaded both receipts to Ramp now (files attached). Link: <https://ramp.example.com/receipts/12345|receipt#12345>. Total $205. Also, do we need HR sign-off?

Sam HR: cc @Marta (Finance) HR confirms expedited passport fees are usually covered when travel is relocation-related. If manager OKs, we can process. @Lisa can you paste the payment reference from the passport service?

Lisa N: Payment ref: PS-998877. Here's a quick copy of the receipt:
```
Passport Expedited Service
Amount: USD 180.00
Date: 2026-03-12
Ref: PS-998877
Courier: USD 25.00
Total: USD 205.00
```

Ramp Bot: Ramp: Receipt 12345 uploaded by Lisa N. Please submit expense with manager approval within 30 days.

Marta (Finance): Thanks. @Lisa please submit an expense in Ramp under `Relocation` category and include manager approval. We'll code to `RELO-TRAVEL` and process via payroll/one-off non-taxable relocation reimbursement. Expect payment in 1-2 pay cycles. :thumbsup:

Lisa N: Done — expense submitted and manager (Javier) approved it in Ramp. Any other docs needed?

Alex K: Nope all set from finance side. Logging note: expedited passport fees for relocation approved up to $300. Filing as non-taxable relocation reimbursement. Closing thread.
